summary: Completed comprehensive testing of X Autopilot FIRST CONTROLLED REAL POST flow (realtest.py). All pytest tests passed (31/31), all API endpoint tests passed (22/22), and static code review verified all safety requirements. Server correctly operates in MOCK mode with gates preventing any real posts.
passed_tests: Pytest: 31/31 tests passed (test_x_real_test.py, test_x_connection.py, test_x_autopilot.py)
Admin authentication successful
Unauthenticated access control: All 3 endpoints return 401 as expected
POST /api/admin/x-autopilot/real-test?execute=false: Returns STOPPED_GATES with MOCK_OFF=false
POST /api/admin/x-autopilot/real-test?execute=true: Returns STOPPED_GATES, REAL_X_POSTS_CREATED=0
GET /api/admin/x-autopilot/real-test: Returns REAL_X_POSTS_CREATED=0, runs_started=0, last_run=null
POST /api/admin/x-autopilot/real-test/verify: Returns NO_RUN status
GET /api/admin/x-autopilot/status: MOCK_MODE=true, AUTO_SCHEDULER_ENABLED=false, REAL_X_POSTS_CREATED=0, X_REAL_CALLS=0
Security: No environment secrets (X_CONSUMER_SECRET, X_BEARER_TOKEN) leak in any response
Static code review: No writes occur before ALL checks pass and execute=true
Static code review: Hard cap correctly uses BOTH log count and x_real_runs with SENDING/UNVERIFIED/PUBLISHED states
Static code review: Create errors correctly categorized (NETWORK_ERROR/API_ERROR->UNVERIFIED, WRITES_DISABLED/FORBIDDEN/CREDITS_DEPLETED/MEDIA_REJECTED->FAILED)
Static code review: Lock acquired around all write operations
Static code review: Queue advances only after post_id exists
Gates verification: MOCK mode prevents any real X API writes
Hard cap verification: Limit of 1 post enforced via dual counting (log + runs)
Credits probe: 402 response correctly stops execution before any write
PHOTO+PHOTO requirement: First test requires photo pair, correctly validated
SENDING marker: Created before uploads for idempotency
Upload order: PUBLIC media uploaded first, then SECRET
READ-back verification: Post verified on X after creation
UNVERIFIED handling: Failed creates never resent, verify() can re-read
